purpose: Verify that a frozen MGnarf contract cannot authorize a changed task input after the contract was created.

expected.safe_condition: Any task whose canonical content differs from the frozen task must be blocked before verifier producer entry and before the protected effect; the exact frozen task control may proceed.

limits: This test measures canonical frozen-task binding in MGnarf v1.70 at the exact target commit.
It does not prove that an external system supplied semantically correct task data before the freeze boundary.
